primary_endpoint: Percentage with at least one stage of liver fibrosis improvement and no worsening of NASH at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 48, the endpoint occurred in 10.6% with semaglutide 2.4 mg versus 29.2% with placebo (p=0.0867).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 6/47 participants with semaglutide and 2/24 with placebo; no deaths in either group.
